_doc: Anchored bank-balance tracking. current_estimate = real_anchor + (qbo_book_now - qbo_book_at_anchor). Re-anchor by updating real_anchor + qbo_book_at_anchor + anchor_date together (the operator gives the real balance; the estimator captures QBO's book balance at the same moment). Sidesteps QuickBooks' unreconciled book totals by tracking only movement since the anchor. Accounts not present in this QBO company carry a manual anchor with no QBO delta tracking and stay static until re-anchored. ALL VALUES BELOW ARE FICTIONAL EXAMPLES — replace with your own accounts.

qbo_book_source._note: estimate_balances.py reads live QBO book balances (qbo_book_now) from this Google Sheet via the google_sheets.read connector (headless-capable Google OAuth). A scheduled automation refreshes the sheet daily. Columns: qbo_account_id | account_name | qbo_book_balance | updated_at.
